name: zmath_mat_copy_current_to
description: zMath::MatCopyCurrentTo copies the current 4x3 matrix into the caller-provided output buffer and returns that buffer.
known_limits: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs under local manifest zmath_mat_current_accessors verifies this helper with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x473210 copies 12 dwords from *g_currentMatrixPtrSlot into the out argument and returns out.
